'''Shaft 14''' was a mining shaft located on [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]]. In [[3631 BBY]] the miners desecrated the tomb of a [[Xivhkalrainik's father|Kaleesh warrior]], and in response his son [[Xivhkalrainik|Xalek]] started attacking their mining camps. Shaft 14 was among those targeted, with Xalek slaughtering everyone and leaving no survivors.<ref name="TOR" />
